$comment: The cue bank (BUILD_PLAN 13.2, 13.6 A1, S5; GAME_DESIGN 13.2, 13.3, 13.11). Every cue is a recipe that web/js/audio/dsp.js synthesizes, the same bits in Node and on the phone: layers of a wave (sine, pulse, square, saw, triangle or noise) or another cue, each at a time (s), with an envelope (a: the attack; d: the decay to -60 dB; s, hold and r for a sustained note), filters (lp1 and hp1, one-pole; bandpass, peak, lowpass and highpass, RBJ biquads) and a level (dB); the cue's own level; and its variants (n of them, spread over +-cents in pitch and +-db in level, each rendered once at unlock, one picked per play by the sound's own generator, never the game's). bus is the 13.11 bus it plays on. scenes are what tools/listen.mjs and the debug menu's 10-second render mix. A1's four cues are the chunky UI voice: dry, quiet, short, each with its weight between 800 Hz and 5 kHz for a phone's speaker; S6 adds the compass roll's tick and its landing, and an outcome's two- and three-tick cues, in the same voice. Every cue is logged in credits.json. The build stamps each variant's golden hash into the shipped copy (audio/sounds.json) and refuses one that differs from test/golden/audio/a1.json.

ui.tick.when: Any choice tap (GAME_DESIGN 13.2: a dry tick)

ui.next.when: Walk on, until A2's walk-on montage, and Next elsewhere (13.2: two dry clicks)

ui.open.when: The menu opens; the (i) square (13.2: a soft wooden tick)

ui.sound_on.when: Sound turned on: one chunky blip, a square with its octave at once (13.2: UI cues are ticks, quiet, never a melody; nothing on the trail rises like the Bonfire Lily's five notes)

ui.compass.when: The compass roll's needle, a tick at each 12 degrees of its travel, so the ticks slow as it does (S6; 13.2: dry wooden ticks that slow)

ui.land.when: The compass needle comes to rest in its band: two ticks falling (S6; 13.2)

ui.good.when: An outcome that went well, as it shows (S6; 13.2: two soft wooden ticks at one pitch, quiet, never a melody)

ui.mishap.when: An outcome that cost something, a mishap or a setback, as it shows (S6; 13.2: two soft ticks, the second a minor third lower)

ui.serious.when: A serious or trip-ending outcome, as it shows (S6; 13.2: three soft ticks falling, quiet, never a melody)

ui_demo.what: The UI cues in turn every 500 ms, each cycling its variants, on the UI bus through the limiter: what the debug menu's Render 10 s of this scene plays (S6 adds the compass's two and the outcomes' three)

silence.what: Nothing: the limiter's noise floor, all zeros
